decisions.reason: The firm has invested in and publicly committed to this waterproof safety shoe range, and any weak results are still seen as temporary, so escalation of commitment leads management to persist.

Given the firm's sunk costs and public commitment to the electrostatic-dissipative occupational shoe, management continues to justify the launch and attributes disappointing outcomes to temporary causes.
As a safety shoe series that represents a visible new direction, the firm remains committed due to prior investment and the need to justify its earlier decision.
